appearanceObservations.light: White mode presents six complete square, full-bleed champion thumbnails in a compact two-column catalogue; bottom gradients keep names and roles readable without hiding the art, and the final row clears persistent chrome
appearanceObservations.dark: Black mode preserves all six image-first cards, identical geometry, readable gradient labels, and the selected tab state with no clipping or content-chrome overlap

Layout.evidence: Two-column square thumbnails create a clear image-led scan order; all six cards and three complete rows are visible above persistent chrome

Typography.evidence: Card names use bold white headlines and roles use quieter white captions over controlled bottom gradients; page title and notice remain subordinate to imagery

Spacing.evidence: Fourteen-point page margins, ten-point gutters, twelve-point label insets, and compact bottom reservation form a consistent rhythm without wasted card padding

Consistency.evidence: Light and dark captures retain the same card geometry, corner treatment, navigation placement, canonical labels, and historical notice

Motion.rationale: Still PNGs contain no transition witness; motion cannot be scored without runtime animation evidence

Iconography.evidence: History, tab, and search glyphs form one coherent system with consistent optical scale and active-state treatment

Depth-Surface.evidence: Full-bleed art, restrained corner strokes, and bottom gradients create depth without heavy shadows or generic container surfaces
